concerns: PERF REGRESSION, the verdict is amber: combatEvents is 30641.4 bytes/iter against its 28186-byte ceiling (28161.1 at the previous run). It does not block the commit or the merge, but it gates the tag, so bump-version will fail it at the next release. The owner asked about CCN and NLOC only, so I changed no code; this needs a ruling before any tag.

Cause: reproduced on repeat runs, so not a flake. Snapshot runs of tests/perf.lua (diagnostic, outside the bundle) walked every commit since the last good one. The first crossing is 5dc2e86 and the largest step is 1ecf7a7 (the chevron commit), which made Panel.Refresh's applyLayout call placeMinMax and tintChevrons. tintChevrons builds a throwaway table with ipairs({ ... }) per refresh, beside new token reads. Which part of the step each accounts for is not measured. Likely fix: drop the per-refresh table in modules/Panel.lua, then re-measure, or re-measure the ceiling in tests/perf.lua with the reason recorded.
The record was stale: the previous bundle measured cd648c8, 61 commits behind this HEAD, so the perf crossing went unrecorded through the v1.80.0-v1.83.0 runs.
proposals: Fix tintChevrons in modules/Panel.lua (no per-refresh table), re-run perf, and rule on the ceiling before the next release.
